decisions.reason: A startup accelerator sits far from the firm's machinery core and has no reported results, so problemistic search could redirect its resources, but the firm's current growth and slack let it carry the program for now.

The bio-based bitumen binder lies outside the core recycling-plant business and has only a product page with no market evidence, making it vulnerable, yet the growing firm has enough slack to keep it while results remain uncertain.

The infectious waste plant is close to the core WASTX line, was launched prominently on the home page and is backed by an ERMAFA partnership, so it likely meets aspirations and gives little reason to search for alternatives.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the core decentralized recycling offer, is featured as the latest product and fits the strategic direction, so management has strong reasons to keep it.
